Welcome to the wiki. Use the sidebar to jump into topics or the search box to quickly find a page.

## How to add a page

- Create a new `.qmd` in this folder.
- Add it to `wiki/_metadata.yml` under `sidebar.contents` so it shows up in navigation.
- Link between pages with standard markdown links, e.g. `[Sample Page](sample-page.qmd)`.

### Try it out

Start with the sample page: [Sample Page](sample-page.qmd).
